page_title: Free AI Song Generator & Music Maker | Boppy AI

sources.entry: Boppy - Free AI music generator — describe a song, AI writes lyrics and generates full audio. Any genre, no signup.

summary.name: Boppy
summary.one_liner: Boppy is a free web and mobile AI song generator that writes lyrics from a text description and sings them over a full arrangement.
use_cases: make a custom song from a text idea
write and sing lyrics for a personal gift song
generate background music for videos and reels
summary.what_it_does: Boppy takes a plain-language description of a song (topic, mood, genre, or story) and uses an AI language model to write original lyrics and a description of the sound. Users can edit lyrics before generation or leave them empty for an instrumental. The track is generated with the ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo model, powered by deAPI.ai, producing a full arrangement with vocals. On the web, users can download an MP3 or share a unique link to each track.
notable: No account or card needed on the web
Built on ACE-Step, an open-weight music model, though the service itself is hosted and closed
Optional Premium in the mobile apps adds 5-minute songs, ad-free allowance and Voice Clone
Terms allow commercial use of generated songs without crediting Boppy
caveats: Web songs are limited to 2 minutes and a daily limit, with ads
Premium is only available in the iOS and Android apps, not on the web
Not open source; hosted service with nothing to self-host
Copyright status of AI-generated songs is unsettled; platform monetization and distribution rules are set by third parties
